name: Amazon Cognito
solves: Provides AWS SDK clients for Amazon Cognito user pools and identity pools — managed sign-up/sign-in, federated IdPs, MFA, and AWS credential vending for mobile and web apps in the AWS ecosystem.
best_for: AWS-centric architectures that want managed user pools integrated with IAM, API Gateway, and Lambda
Enterprises standardized on Cognito for compliance, VPC, and AWS Organizations controls
Mobile/web apps using Amplify Auth that already target Cognito user pools
Workloads needing federated enterprise IdPs into AWS-authenticated backends
Teams that prefer pay-as-you-go AWS identity over a separate auth SaaS vendor
skip_when: You want a delightful pre-built auth UI and DX comparable to Clerk without Amplify/custom UI work
You are not on AWS and do not want Cognito/IAM coupling
You need the simplest possible Next.js auth setup — Cognito configuration and SDK surface are heavy
You prefer open-source self-hosted Auth.js/Better Auth on your own database
Developer experience and docs clarity matter more than AWS ecosystem fit
